headline: IT services showed mixed growth with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while profit margins pressured.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest single‑digit to over 50% YoY, led by Coforge and HCLTech. Profit expansion was uneven; Infosys and Wipro saw slower profit growth or declines despite revenue gains. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and newly introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlook. AI contributed to top‑line growth for several firms but did not translate uniformly into higher margins.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies such as Infosys, HCLTech and LTM highlighted double‑digit AI revenue growth, supporting deal wins and higher margins.

themes.title: Margin pressure amid higher costs
themes.detail: Despite revenue gains, operating margins slipped for Infosys and Wipro, reflecting cost pressures and lower profitability.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 11.5% YoY, profit jumped 21% and AI revenue reached $219 m.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and margin guidance is flat.
